_note: Current-year (2026) overlay for the Vitals dashboard. The monthly Planning Center pull rewrites this file, then build_vitals.py bakes it over the frozen 2022-2025 history from MCC VITALS.xlsx. 'value' = the number shown; 'pct' = the % column (growth for attendance rows, share of attendance/adults otherwise; null where none). Giving uses 'value'=per-person/week $ and 'total'=YTD dollars. Metrics omitted here keep their spreadsheet value.
